total_levels.title: Number of segmentation levels to quantify (optional)
total_levels.description: Levels 1..N, generically named. Not needed if 'Labels contract' below is set, or if the input masks already carry a segmentation_provenance.json sidecar (Stage 3a segment output does, automatically). One of the three is required.

labels_json_dataset.title: Labels contract (optional)
labels_json_dataset.description: Only needed when quantifying masks that have no segmentation_provenance.json sidecar (e.g. masks produced outside this pipeline). Upload a labels.json ({"labels": {"1": "...", ...}}) as a 'Files' dataset (exactly one .json) and select it here.

merge_before_quantify.title: Merge multiple segmentation sources first
merge_before_quantify.description: Enable if supplying more than one segmentation per exam (e.g. model output plus a manual correction).

quantify_n_threads.title: Threads (file I/O parallelism across the whole run)
quantify_n_threads.description: File I/O parallelism across the whole run. Leave blank to use the task's allocated CPU count (recommended); set only to override.
